intent: Icon-only kit Button: a square action with an icon and a required accessible name.
useWhen: A toolbar or row action where the icon is enough, like Download, More or Add
A compact action beside a field or a title, where a label would not fit
Icon actions joined in a ButtonGroup
doNotUseWhen: The action needs a visible label — use Button with iconStart
The icon alone could be misread — use Button with a label
Navigation to another page — use Link
A main action with a menu of other actions — use SplitButton

icon.note: A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case), a Lucide component, or an element. Same rules as Button iconStart.

ariaLabel.note: Names the action, like Download. There is no visible label.

size.note: A square of control-height: sm 32, md 36, lg 40. The same height as a labelled Button, Input and Select of that size.

appearance.note: Same as Button. Toolbars usually use outline or ghost with mode neutral.

loading.note: Same as Button loading. The spinner takes the place of the icon.

requirements: ariaLabel is required and names the action
Add a kit Tooltip with the same words when the icon is not obvious

doNot: Do not build a local icon button — IconButton renders the kit Button, so it has no look of its own
Do not pass custom SVG markup — use a Lucide name or Lucide component
Do not use more than one appearance=solid mode=primary IconButton or Button in a view
snippet:
<IconButton icon="Download" ariaLabel="Download" appearance="outline" mode="neutral" />
<ButtonGroup ariaLabel="Invoice actions"><IconButton icon="Download" ariaLabel="Download" appearance="outline" mode="neutral" /><IconButton icon="Ellipsis" ariaLabel="More" appearance="outline" mode="neutral" /><IconButton icon="Plus" ariaLabel="Add invoice" appearance="outline" mode="neutral" /></ButtonGroup>
